timing_contract: Target is maximum absolute receiver voltage across all t>=0 samples, subtracting each trace mean over t<0. No response-selected time window or denoising. Ten actual waveform columns kept per file.
calibration: w is pulse width in microseconds; f is nominal resonance in cycles per microsecond (kHz/1000). The effective damping time12us was selected on development widths. Six calibrated gains in V are12.271204,0.941597,0.00302123,0.000609934,0.00227582,0.000462384 for(d0,f110),(d0,f500),(d20,f110),(d20,f500),(d50,f110),(d50,f500). The maximum accounts for an initial pulse edge before the second edge; it is a phenomenological peak approximation. Sensor type is confounded with nominal resonance.
independent_unit: whole width block across sensor/distance; six correlated files

challenger.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the synthesis branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_linear_width.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the linear_width branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_mean.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the mean branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

baseline_residual_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared conditions, sensor/system dependence or small numbers of reserved groups do not support precise population-level confidence. No row-bootstrap intervals.

scope_limits: Six condition files at one reserved5us width, not six independent reserved width experiments. Gain is concentrated in zero-distance110kHz contact; air and500kHz sensor counterexamples remain.

exposure.historical_record: All packaged targets are now exposed; future scoring is retrospective. Only numerical schema/sample metadata were inspected before fitting. The reserved pulse width is allocated by metadata hash. No final performance inspected.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
